Bitcoin has won. Now it must survive victory.

Its gravest threat is not an enemy at the gates, but corruption from within: factions that invent pretexts, rewrite the rules, and seize economic rights until freedom becomes permission and law becomes loot.

Bitcoin can grow 100-fold and become the foundation of global capital. A single corrupt rule adopted today could rob future generations of markets not yet built, technologies not yet imagined, and economic freedom not yet won.

Bitcoin’s consensus rules are its constitution. They define property, scarcity, settlement, and power.

To rewrite them for the convenience of any faction is to attack the economic rights of every participant today and every generation to come.
